title: Order fulfilment: sales -> delivery, purchase -> receipt
summary: The links Odoo makes in sale_stock and purchase_stock: confirming an order creates a delivery/receipt, validating it updates delivered/received quantities and order delivery/receipt status.
design: Odoo-inspired, Mendix-native (intake Q3): Odoo is the functional reference; simplifications listed and signed off at the Stage 2 gate

useCases.title: Sales order creates a delivery
preconditions: Sales order confirmed with storable/consumable goods lines
postconditions: One delivery transfer (WH/OUT) with a move per goods line, linked to the order
mainFlow: 1. On confirm (F004 UC003) system creates a delivery from WH/Stock to Customers for the delivery address
2. One move per product line of type Goods (services skipped), scheduled = order date + customer lead time
3. System confirms the delivery and checks availability

useCases.title: Delivery updates the sales order
postconditions: Order lines QuantityDelivered and order DeliveryStatus updated; invoice status recomputed
mainFlow: 1. On transfer done, system adds done quantities (converted to the line unit) to QuantityDelivered
2. Order DeliveryStatus: NotDelivered / Started / PartiallyDelivered / FullyDelivered
3. Invoice status recomputed for delivered-quantity products

useCases.title: Changing quantities on a confirmed sales order
mainFlow: 1. User increases a line quantity: system adds the difference to the open delivery (or a new one)
2. Decreasing below delivered quantity is refused

useCases.title: Purchase order creates a receipt
postconditions: One receipt (WH/IN) linked to the PO
mainFlow: 1. On approval (F005) system creates a receipt from Vendors to WH/Stock with a move per goods line, scheduled = expected arrival

useCases.title: Receipt updates the purchase order
postconditions: QuantityReceived and ReceiptStatus updated; billing status recomputed
mainFlow: 1. On transfer done, system adds done quantities to QuantityReceived
